scope: Independent structural and documentary completeness review of all 24 consolidated pages. This is not another image-reading pass and does not reassess ink decisions.
methods: Read the task prompt, source PREAMBLE, existing validation/assembly/freeze/archive scripts, final page fragments, reports and second-reading metadata.
Used a lexer that consumes control symbols such as \\ atomically; did not mistake row breaks followed by X, k, i or j for unknown commands.

Checked math modes and group boundaries with explicit text-argument handling, 688 dollar tokens, 56 displayed-math openings, 1020 ordinary groups, and 18 matched left/right delimiter pairs plus one middle delimiter.
Read all 9 tikz-cd and 5 TikZ environment bodies for row/column, arrow-target, path, coordinate, node and semicolon structure.
Reviewed existing validator coverage first and ran its read-only in-progress validation after additional checks.

tex_commands.notes: All actual control words belong to the supplied macros or standard LaTeX/amsmath/amssymb/ulem/TikZ/tikz-cd. No added packages or preamble are required by the written command inventory.

tex_structure.only_illegible_occurrence: scan038 cancelled prose, not a formula or diagram

diagrams_and_drawings.comment: TikZ on scans060/061 draws annotation/folio strokes, not running text; labels are ordinary typeset nodes or text.

check_events.place_target_exception: scan053.final_closed_immersion_claim explicitly identifies the final manuscript claim and its counterexample/refinement in N3/N12; this is a permitted place target.
check_events.type_interpretation: Refutation rows either name the refinement in type or use the literal refuted phrase with the concrete refined id in outcome. No type-only placeholder lacks an actual refined id.
check_events.visual_checks_as_math_events: No purely visual-only event identified in the inspected event rows.

existing_validator.coverage_gaps: Does not validate math-mode macro expansion, dollar nesting, control-word allowlist or refined-id resolution. Those were separately inspected here.

archive_input_layout.comment: Final archive not built or altered in this audit; the script includes all work files except ZIPs and Python cache files.

findings.problem: The supplied PREAMBLE defines math-mode \unsure as a group followed by ^{?}. Appending ^* to that macro result attaches a second superscript to the same atom. Ordinary brace and dollar counts do not detect this.
findings.reasoning: Expansion has the form {<reading>}^{?}^*_{z,Z}. The starred glyph and doubt are intended, but the TeX atom needs grouping.
findings.repair_scope: Root may group the final page atom and regenerate the combined/final display records. Preserve the original first/second TSV strings, boxes and historical comparisons.

findings.status: implementation-dependent; not asserted to be a compilation failure
findings.problem: These ulem arguments contain explicit math dollars while the surrounding source is already in displayed math. A scanner that treats ulem arguments as inheriting math mode flags six nested-dollar tokens. The result depends on ulem math-mode handling, which this review did not establish.
findings.qualification: The supplied PREAMBLE loads ulem but does not define its implementation. Local package lookup found no installed ulem.sty. No TeX compilation or external lookup was performed; therefore these are review items, not confirmed errors.
findings.suggested_review: Consider an explicit text wrapper containing the intended math segment, e.g. \text{\uuline{$...$}} or \text{\uline{$...$}}, with appropriate math style for a subscript, if root elects to make mode handling explicit. Preserve the underlined span and all raw readings.

finalization_gates_not_failures: Finish the remaining root adjudication(s), preserving original first/second text and box lists.
Resolve the confirmed superscript syntax problem and review ulem mode handling before the transcription freeze.
Run final-mode validation, freeze the 24 page files plus the combined fragment (25 hashes), write freeze and unchanged-hash verification to progress.log, and verify at the end.
Build SP94_C13_151.zip containing all mandatory deliverables and work documentation/crops, excluding attached originals, native halves and earlier ZIPs; offer that ZIP as the only final download.
limitations: No TeX compiler was run, as instructed. Static structural validation cannot certify rendered layout.
No new image-based completeness determination was attempted; inventory completeness is checked against the recorded reports and required schemas.
Parent is actively finalizing pages; this report records a time-specific snapshot. Current 059/060 adjudication status is not treated as a defect.
ulem implementation was unavailable locally, so the nested-dollar underline observations remain qualified review items.
overall: Documentary counts and integrity checks pass. One definite macro-expansion syntax issue needs a structural repair; three explicit-dollar underline occurrences require qualified review.
